accepted_scope: The literal trace-determinant tensor has the printed pointwise formula and is alternating. Given accepted raw field-candidate and coordinate checks, the noncomputable compatible and decomposition checks imply the all-vector literal trace-tensor identity plus the actual residual pullback.
remaining: Field cardinality, nonzero scalar and support rank bounds use separate accepted theorems. This checker requires proof inputs and noncomputable quotient-field/trace constructions; it is not a standalone executable verifier, refinement or charged-cost theorem.
